ms.promise: A live and functioning V2 version of the Indigo Protocol on the Cardano mainnet.
ms.criteria: Successful deployment is evidenced by the smooth operation of the V2 protocol on the mainnet, with all functionalities working as intended and no critical issues.
ms.report:
Transaction that submits upgrade to protocol: https://cexplorer.io/tx/8bb9c5228f2abd74c4d7792ce979c1212927f22668d5f75c667aa2d191b68ae5
Datum of Version Record: https://cexplorer.io/datum/77a7630d54bbbfca54a1f2bc34925914a58eabf1a04a7ad6a81caf70c130b267
Temp Check for V2 Deployment: https://forum.indigoprotocol.io/t/temperature-check-for-dao-approval-proposal-to-deploy-indigo-protocol-v2/13850
This transaction creates a "Version Record," which is a UTxO that v1 contracts can use to get instructions on how to upgrade from V1 to V2. The creation of this transaction marks the successful deployment of Indigo Protocol V2.
To verify that the proper upgrade was utilized, you can view the datum of the version record and check that the "V2 Upgrade Minting Policies" and "V2 Validator Hashes" in the Temp Check for V2 Deployment match the records in the datum.
Video of Web App Interaction: https://youtu.be/MpHY_yuPryg
Transaction in Web App: https://cexplorer.io/tx/6144fd08e8090b5488ba2781a9a6511cab831644b14c85e2d6893c4004d81816
In the video, the user opens a iBTC CDP with 10 ADA. This demonstrates the successful interaction with the Indigo v2 smart contracts via the Indigo web app.

ms.promise: A publicly available, comprehensive audit report, along with an executive summary.
ms.criteria: The published report must be accessible to the public and provide a thorough analysis of the audit findings. The executive summary should effectively communicate the main points to a wider audience. Acceptance is based on the availability and quality of these publications.
ms.report:
We decided to change the platform on which we provided the audit completion with the Indigo community. We utilized Discourse through a DAO Temp Check to share:
・An Audit Executive Summary
・A brief explanation of the test suite and upgrade path
・The V2 smart contract validator hashes.

We decided at the time of the release to the public not to share the full audit report details and leave the audit summary at a high level, however we are willing to share that report now. We hope that the full audit report will satisfy the "thorough analysis of the audit findings:" https://drive.google.com/file/d/12XgsZ52Td8dHgoFmbblHZ0nk1RguZbR9/view?usp=sharing 
In addition, the executive summary did not outline any specifics about what was found, however the audit report does share any "Implemented Solution and Security Enhancements" for each "issue" found. We hope that this will satisfy the reviewers request basically for more information.
Link to temp check: https://forum.indigoprotocol.io/t/temperature-check-for-dao-approval-proposal-to-deploy-indigo-protocol-v2/13850
This temp check was shared with the community through X and Discord:

ms.promise: Project Closeout Report and Project Closeout Video
ms.criteria:
The Project Clouseout Report has a length of 2/3 pages and provides a summary of the most important KPIs and how they were (or were not) addressed. Specifically, it includes:
- Name of project and Project URL on IdeaScale/Fund
- Project Number
- Name of project manager
- Date project started
- Date project completed
- List of challenge KPIs and how the project addressed them
- List of project KPIs and how the project addressed them
- Key achievements
- Key learnings
- Next steps for the product or service developed
- Final thoughts/comments
- Links to other relevant project sources or document
